name: House Emesh
description: An Abzan house whose old representative wants active defenses.

timeline.summary: The heads of the clan houses gather to swear kinship, and Anafenza receives them at the Amber Throne.
timeline.quote: The houses had elected Anafenza to be khan

timeline.summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
timeline.quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.

pages_say.description: An Abzan house that pledges kinship to Anafenza.
An Abzan house whose elderly representative holds a grudge against Jeskai trespass.
An Abzan house whose old representative wants active defenses.
